claude.rationale: gap_45 is 0 because the customer-facing asset (the distribution facility) "did not exist at closing — it was to be constructed by the JV," so no product crossed the ownership boundary at all; there is no product-vs-process mismatch when neither an operating product nor its delivery processes moved. gap_56 is 0 because no going-concern operations, workforce, or people/organization transferred ("no operating facility, workforce, or going-concern business crossed the ownership boundary"); only capital, land, and entitlements entered the new development vehicle, and management authority was split by function within the JV rather than a process transferring without its organization. This is a newly formed 50/50 Delaware LLC with imprint-share intent (equal 50% partners), a swap into a new legal vehicle, and a lease (as amended) bridging the parties' roles.

gemini.rationale: The transaction is a 50/50 joint venture to develop a distribution facility. At closing, only land, entitlements, and cash were contributed to the new JV. No operating facility, workforce, or going-concern business crossed the boundary (T5 and T6 are null). Therefore, there are no structural gaps between product/asset and operations (gap_45 = 0) or operations and workforce (gap_56 = 0).

grok.rationale: The slice states that at closing 'no operating facility, workforce, or going-concern business crossed the ownership boundary; the transaction transferred capital, land, and entitlements into a new development vehicle,' and that the customer-facing distribution facility 'did not exist at closing — it was to be constructed by the JV.' Accordingly neither T4 product nor T5 processes moved (gap_45=0), and neither T5 processes nor T6 organization moved (gap_56=0); only a new 50/50 LLC and a contingent amended lease were put in place.
